text:
june: Hey @support, we're seeing lots of 429s and high latency from our dedicated pool since last night. Traffic spiked but dedicated capacity should have handled it. Example request id: rq_9a3f, tenant: tenant-zenith-42. Responses often 8-12s or 429s, especially for long streaming responses.

alex: Thanks June — sorry about that. Can you paste a full sample request id + timestamp and confirm if this happens on streaming and non-streaming? Also which plan is the tenant on?

june: rq_9a3f at 2026-03-16T22:14:08Z. Happens on both streaming and non-streaming, more frequent on longer outputs. I also noticed a weird quota unit in the tenant UI that said `units_per: minute` which seemed off.

sam: looking now. Pulling limiter logs for tenant-zenith-42... found entries like: `rate_limiter: tenant=tenant-zenith-42 limit=3600 unit=minute used=3601` — that looks like minute-level units. Should be per_hour for this plan. Paging quota service to investigate mapping.

maria: fwiw autoscaler scaled down the pool at 22:10 due to low GPU util (lots of queued, CPU-heavy token assembly). That made the pool fragile to bursts; queueing increased and calls hit rate limits faster. Suggest temporary increase to burst capacity and adjust scale-down grace.

alex: can you paste the tenant quota config page screenshot/text? june: can you confirm plan name?

june: tenant on `pro-dedicated-50k`. Snippet from tenant config: ```quota:
  limit: 3600
  units_per: minute
  burst: 1200``` I expected `limit: 3600 units_per: hour`.

sam: that's the bug. During a plan migration the unit got set to `minute` instead of `hour`. Root cause appears to be the migration script that copies `units_denominator` without translating legacy cardinality. We can hotfix by changing this tenant's unit to `hour` and reloading the limiter.

alex: I'm going to apply a temporary per-tenant override to prevent more 429s while we patch migration: `rate_override tenant-zenith-42 limit=43200 units_per=hour` (43200 tokens/hr). Also bump dedicated pool burst by +1 GPU for 10m.

ops-bot: deploy-started by @alex — patch: rate-migrate-fix #4321

sam: override applied and mapping patched, reloaded limiter. New limiter log: `rate_limiter: tenant=tenant-zenith-42 limit=43200 unit=hour used=123` — looks green on the limiter side.

june: testing now... initial results much better. Small calls latency down to ~200-400ms, long streaming still 2-3s but no 429s so far. Thank you.

maria: I'll follow up with autoscaler changes: increase min-replicas 2->3 and scale-down grace 120s->600s to avoid premature scale-in during bursts. I'll also schedule an audit job to find other tenants with `units_per` mismatches from migration.

alex: June, we'll keep monitoring and open a postmortem with timeline and actions. Can you confirm approximate spike start time to include in the PM?

june: spike started ~22:05 UTC. Thanks team :rocket:

alex: thanks :thumbsup: closing action items: (1) applied override, (2) patched migration script, (3) autoscaler change scheduled, (4) postmortem will be created and shared. If you see any regressions ping here and we'll reopen.
